summary: An open two-seat sand buggy: a full tube roll cage of individual members (main hoop with diagonal, front hoop… joints steering, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer, wheel_f_r_roll, wheel_f_r_steer, wheel_r_l_roll, …; options paint; sockets seat_driver, seat_pax_1, eye_point, socket_roof, socket_tow, exhaust_0, ….
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.dune_buggy or place "prefab": "dune_buggy" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
